pages.title: Chemical Reactor
pages.text: A pressure vessel with a catalyst bed, a heater and a stirrer. Most of chemistry is getting the right molecules to meet at the right energy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Most early chemistry runs here: catalysts, solvents, bonds and nanomaterials.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 3 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Autocatalytic Broth, Brownian Suspension, Buckyball Cage, Carbon Nanotube Bundle, Chiral Crystal, Ferrofluid, Graphene Sheet, Metal-Organic Framework, Molecular Orbital Lattice, Muonic Catalyst, Noble Gas Clathrate, Partition Function Matrix, Positronium Hydride, Primordial Soup...
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Chemical Reactor$(): Bioreactor, Nuclide Forge
